about_the_game:
《Witchcrafter The TCG》 Has Arrived!

《Witchcrafter The TCG》is a trading card game inspired by shamanic and spirit folklore from cultures around the world.

Featuring both PvP and single-player modes, the game includes over 2,000 unique cards for players to collect, build, and enhance their ultimate dream decks — while exploring a world rich with lore and cultural depth.

Each spirit card carries its own story, attributes, values, race, and abilities.

By combining them with Trap and Magic Cards — and strategically choosing whether to summon face-up or set them face-down — players can instantly shift the flow of battle.

Every move and every deck composition matters, requiring careful thought and strategy to prepare for every possible outcome.

Discover the Stories Behind the Cards

Step into a world where magic meets strategy — a realm where every duel is a test of wit and instinct.
Build your custom deck, summon Spirit, Witch, Trap, or Magic Cards, and challenge top duelists from across the globe!

With fast-paced, dynamic gameplay, 《Witchcrafter The TCG》 lets you enjoy thrilling battles anytime, anywhere.
Start your journey with beginner-friendly decks, unlock powerful new cards as you progress, customize, strengthen, and forge your way to the top — become the ultimate Witchcrafter!

Game Features

  • Global PvP Battles – Compete against players worldwide and claim the highest honors.

  • Ultimate Deck Customization – Mix and match from classic spells to rare characters to build your strongest lineup.

  • Immersive Gameplay Experience – Every card has its own backstory and ability, making every duel full of surprises.

  • PvP & Single-Player Modes – Explore the spiritual essence of Witchcrafter and uncover the legends behind every card.

The Origin of《Witchcrafter The TCG》

From gameplay design and programming to the card mechanics, 《Witchcrafter The TCG》 was developed, written, and produced by Fok Tsz Lam, with support from a passionate creative team dedicated to crafting a one-of-a-kind card game experience — one that blends deep strategy, distinctive cultural elements, and a rich world setting.

Published by Spear Entertainment, the game made its debut in 2025, quickly becoming one of the most talked-about next-generation card battle titles.

In-game purchases available, including new card packs obtainable with Steam Wallet funds.
